dataset.count_note: The pinned checkout used by the executable audit contains 328 CSV annotation files, matching the dataset README. GitHub code-search indexing is not used as an integrity source.

claim_boundary: This audit studies whether high-frequency temporal predecessor relations learned from training sequences survive held-out labeled-correct behavior and whether their violations carry signal for explicit ordering mistakes. It does not identify mechanical prerequisites, causal necessity, or a complete action-applicability model.
